crossRefs.note: If any of the meat of the sacrifice of his peace offerings is eaten on the third day, it will not be accepted, and it…
You shall not eat any abominable thing.
Yahweh, don’t I hate those who hate you? Am I not grieved with those who rise up against you?
I hate them with perfect hatred. They have become my enemies.
One who walks with wise men grows wise, but a companion of fools suffers harm.
A dishonest man detests the righteous, and the upright in their ways detest the wicked.
But for the cowardly, unbelieving, sinners, abominable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all…

parallels.note: These you may eat of all that are in the waters: you may eat whatever has fins and scales.
You shall not eat whatever doesn’t have fins and scales. It is unclean to you.

translations.web: All that don’t have fins and scales in the seas and rivers, all that move in the waters, and all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination to you,
translations.bsb: But the following among all the teeming life and creatures in the water are detestable to you: everything in the seas or streams that does not have fins and scales.
translations.kjv: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of any living thing which is in the waters, they shall be an abomination
translations.asv: And all that have not fins and scales in the seas, and in the rivers, of all that move in the waters, and of all the living creatures that are in the waters, they are an abomination unto you,
